text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa and I are headed to the

academy after a day out when...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. You know much about
amusement parks?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: My little sister's coming to visit.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And apparently, my mom's getting us
some
tickets to an amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Just take her for me! And don't you get
up to
anything dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh. Like I'd do anything to put her at
risk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Try putting yourself in my shoes for a
minute. You
know she likes to copy
everything you do!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess. Ugh. This is such a pain...
choice_data_list: 下見しておきたいってことか
下見しておきたいってことだね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If that's her reason, there's no way I can
turn her
down. We decide to head
straight to an
amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Wow, people are even here this late...
Why does
this feel sorta... nostalgic?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yup, which is why I wanted to do a
preliminary
inspection. C'mon, let's
wander around.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Looks pretty peaceful.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All right. This place is clear. No danger
or bad
influence anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
None, really... That's why I don't go to
these
places.
choice_data_list: ナカヤマは好きなアトラクションないのか？
ナカヤマは好きなアトラクションないの？

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I guess when I was a kid, though, I was
hooked on
the haunted houses and
roller coasters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she likes to copy Nakayama Festa,
she'll
probably enjoy those thrilling
attractions too.
choice_data_list: 妹さんも喜びそうだな
妹さんも喜びそうだね

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Maybe... Anyway, next is...

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for coming today.
The park
will be closing shortly...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. We got here pretty late. I bet we
have time
to check out one more thing
though.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's getting dark too, so now's the
perfect time for
it. Let's go.
choice_data_list: やっぱり、お化け屋敷かな
遊園地といえばジェットコースター！

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Not bad. The set looks pretty
convincing. The
scares will probably be
decent too. I bet even
she'll—
Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What was that?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A-ahhh! Nakayama! I'm so glad you're
here!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Falcon? What're you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm, uh, trying to get pumped up before
the
concert, so I thought I'd practice
doing something
b-brave, and...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I-I made it this far, but I can't go any
further!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're that scared?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm that scared! There's a countess
covered in
blood and a monster covered
in bandages!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And they even chase after you!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Really? That sounds like fun. Where do
we go to
find them?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No! It's too scary... Wh-what if you have
a heart
attack?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It may be no big deal for Nakayama
Festa, but
with these kinds of frights
inside, I doubt her little
sister will
manage to keep the same calm.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You're right. Good thing we came
to check
things out first.
choice_data_list: 妹さんには厳しいんじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Your sister?! Unless she's as fearless as
you, she'll
absolutely end up crying!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I guess we'll skip the haunted
house. Her
crying would be the worst.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But that doesn't mean I can't have fun
right now.
C'mon, don't let me down,
eh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We bring Smart Falcon with us and go
through
the haunted house. Nakayama
Festa seems to
really enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: A quick and easy thrill. Sure, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The speed feels so different from
running
yourself! I can't believe we got
to stand on the
ride too! Haah, that was
so fun! But also so scary!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yeah. You're so high up, and
there are all
those twists and turns. It's a
completely different
experience from
being on the track.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how it would feel to be able to
run like
that...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh? Look who's here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Nakayama! Heya.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So you're here for your sister.
You're so
kind.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: No, I don't really have a choice in this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I think your sister will love the
roller
coaster. I definitely recommend
taking her on it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I shift my gaze to the entrance to the
roller
coaster and see a board there
used to measure
height.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It was so incredibly fast... like whoosh! I
thought I
was gonna—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Fly... off...
choice_data_list: 身長制限があるみたいだ
身長制限があるみたいだよ

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I don't think she's tall enough for it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! I'm sorry! I shouldn't have
recommended it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The ride may be loads of fun, but it
would be
really dangerous if you don't
follow the rules!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Calm down, Spe... Nakayama knows that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The risk might make it even more fun,
actually.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh. Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Playing with danger is my thing. I'm not about to put her through anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we ride the rollercoaster
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The speed and steep drops provided the
exact
kind of thrill Nakayama Festa
enjoys. She seems
really pleased to have
the chance to visit an
amusement park
after so long.
